text: Warning! The Charleston will make us knock-kneed and pigeon-toed!
en: Warning! The Charleston will make us knock-kneed and pigeon-toed!
zh: 警告！查尔斯顿舞会把我们跳成 X 型腿、内八字！
asr_final: Warning, the Charleston will make us knock-need and pigeon-toed.

text: It kicked off on Broadway in nineteen twenty-three. Three years on, it's the rage!
en: It kicked off on Broadway in 1923. Three years on, it's the rage!
zh: 1923 年从百老汇起步，三年后风靡全国！
asr: It kicked off on Broadway in 1923. Three years on, it's the rage.

text: Hollywood star Bessie Love will teach you, in nine easy steps!
en: Hollywood star Bessie Love will teach you, in nine easy steps!
zh: 好莱坞明星贝西·洛夫来教你：九步就会！

text: But in Dearborn, Henry Ford has other ideas!
en: But in Dearborn, Henry Ford has other ideas!
zh: 可在迪尔伯恩，亨利·福特另有主意！

text: Mister Ford's cure? The old-time dances of his youth!
en: Mister Ford's cure? The old-time dances of his youth!
zh: 福特开的药方？他年轻时跳的老式舞！
asr: Mr. Ford's cure? The old-time dances of his youth!

text: His book says the jazzy new dances are losing vogue everywhere!
en: His book says the jazzy new dances are losing vogue everywhere!
zh: 他的书上说：带爵士味的新舞到处失宠！

text: Old-time or Charleston? Let's ask the Ford workers' picnic!
en: Old-time or Charleston? Let's ask the Ford workers' picnic!
zh: 老式舞还是查尔斯顿？去福特工人的野餐会问问！

text: Even the youngsters are doing the Charleston!
en: Even the youngsters are doing the Charleston!
zh: 连小孩都在跳查尔斯顿！
